title: Framework PR #30 Change Record pair violates the current canonical heading contract
title_de: Framework-PR-#30-Change-Record-Paar verletzt den aktuellen kanonischen Überschriftenvertrag
summary: After PR #30 was normally updated with current Framework master, the CI-security Change Record contract rejected the PR's English and German records because four historical follow-up sections used level-2 headings. At refreshed exact head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194, the unchanged CI-security suite passed all 69 tests, documentation checks passed, and all terminal non-skipped hosted checks succeeded. The finding is fixed on the verified PR head; master integration is not authorized in this task.
summary_de: Nachdem PR #30 normal mit dem aktuellen Framework-master aktualisiert wurde, lehnte der CI-Security-Change-Record-Vertrag die englischen und deutschen Records des PR ab, weil vier historische Follow-up-Abschnitte Überschriften auf Ebene 2 verwendeten. Auf dem aktualisierten exakten Head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194 bestand die unveränderte CI-Security-Suite alle 69 Tests, Dokumentationsprüfungen bestanden und alle terminalen nicht übersprungenen Hosted Checks waren erfolgreich. Der Befund ist auf dem verifizierten PR-Head fixed; eine Master-Integration ist in dieser Aufgabe nicht autorisiert.
observed_behavior: Historically, make test-ci-security-contract ran 69 tests; 68 passed and ChangeRecordContractTest.test_checked_in_change_records_pass failed because the paired 20260719-01-remediate-framework-sonarcloud-quality-gate records had headings that did not match the template. At exact head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194, the unchanged CI-security suite passed all 69 tests and the original failure no longer reproduces.
observed_behavior_de: Historisch führte make test-ci-security-contract 69 Tests aus; 68 bestanden und ChangeRecordContractTest.test_checked_in_change_records_pass schlug fehl, weil die gepaarten Records 20260719-01-remediate-framework-sonarcloud-quality-gate Überschriften hatten, die nicht dem Template entsprachen. Auf dem exakten Head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194 bestand die unveränderte CI-Security-Suite alle 69 Tests und der ursprüngliche Fehler reproduziert nicht mehr.
expected_behavior: Both Change Records must retain their reciprocal links, matching Change ID, English/German parity, and all historical information while exposing exactly the canonical 13 level-2 headings required by the current checker. The CI-security Change Record contract must pass unchanged.
expected_behavior_de: Beide Change Records müssen ihre reziproken Links, passende Change-ID, Englisch-/Deutsch-Parität und alle historischen Informationen bewahren, während sie exakt die vom aktuellen Checker verlangten kanonischen 13 Überschriften auf Ebene 2 enthalten. Der CI-Security-Change-Record-Vertrag muss unverändert bestehen.
impact: This is a reproducible required CI failure and a task delivery blocker. It does not establish a vulnerability, but bypassing or changing the checker would weaken release traceability; the repair must therefore be confined to the two records.
impact_de: Dies ist ein reproduzierbarer erforderlicher CI-Fehler und ein Task-Delivery-Blocker. Er belegt keine Schwachstelle, aber ein Umgehen oder Ändern des Checkers würde die Release-Traceability abschwächen; die Reparatur muss daher auf die beiden Records beschränkt bleiben.
preconditions: PR #30 master-update worktree contains current Framework master 9a729226d2e040d07d7e7a4acebf201faf06ab37.
The two existing PR #30 Change Records retain four extra level-2 historical follow-up headings.
The current Change Record checker and its 69-test CI-security suite are present.
reproduction: rtk proxy env <task-owned roots> make -C <Framework PR30 worktree> test-ci-security-contract

evidence.command: rtk proxy env task-owned-roots make -C Framework-PR30-worktree test-ci-security-contract
evidence.summary: One Change Record heading-contract assertion failed while 68 other CI-security tests passed. The retained output identifies both paired PR #30 Change Records and the canonical-heading cause.

evidence.command: Task-root CI-security and documentation checks plus GitHub exact-head check-run/review readback; retained sanitized summary
evidence.summary: At exact PR #30 head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194, the unchanged CI-security suite passed all 69 tests, documentation checks passed, and all terminal non-skipped hosted checks succeeded. No checker, template, traceability control, or exception was changed.

root_cause: The historical PR #30 Change Record pair predates the current strict Change Record checker. It added later historical follow-up narratives as additional level-2 headings rather than as level-3 subsections under the required final review section.
root_cause_de: Das historische PR-#30-Change-Record-Paar stammt vor dem aktuellen strikten Change-Record-Checker. Es fügte spätere historische Follow-up-Narrative als zusätzliche Überschriften auf Ebene 2 statt als Unterabschnitte auf Ebene 3 unter dem erforderlichen finalen Review-Abschnitt hinzu.
proposed_remediation: Demote only the four extra historical follow-up headings in each paired record from level 2 to level 3, preserving their text, canonical headings, Change IDs, links, and language parity. Do not change the checker, test, template, historical content, or CI-security enforcement.
proposed_remediation_de: Nur die vier zusätzlichen historischen Follow-up-Überschriften in jedem gepaarten Record von Ebene 2 auf Ebene 3 herabstufen und Text, kanonische Überschriften, Change-IDs, Links und Sprachparität bewahren. Checker, Test, Template, historischen Inhalt und CI-Security-Enforcement nicht ändern.
acceptance_criteria: Both paired Change Records contain exactly the canonical 13 level-2 headings for their language.
All historical follow-up information remains present as level-3 subsections.
The reciprocal English/German links and matching Change ID remain valid.
make test-ci-security-contract and the direct Change Record contract test pass without any checker or enforcement change.
The final PR #30 diff contains only the paired record formatting/content update for this finding.
validation_plan: Inspect the exact heading lists in both records before and after the minimal formatting repair.
Run the direct Change Record contract module and make test-ci-security-contract with task-owned roots.
Review the paired diff for unchanged record text and English/German parity, then include it in the exact-head CI round.
legitimate_control_tests: The unchanged checker continues to reject missing or noncanonical headings.
The repaired canonical pair is accepted without a legacy exception.
The records retain their reciprocal language links and matching Change ID.
dependencies: Current Framework master Change Record contract
Exact-head CI revalidation after normal push
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-FRAMEWORK-0023. FND-FRAMEWORK-0023 owns SonarQube Cloud duplicate source blocks and shared-helper remediation; this finding owns the independent Change Record structure failure introduced by the normal master update.
evidence_limitations: The retained failure proves the current local CI-security contract result; exact-head hosted CI remains required after the later normal push.
The failure does not identify a runtime or exploitable security defect.
residual_risk: The original heading-contract failure no longer reproduces on exact head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194: the unchanged CI-security suite passed all 69 tests and hosted checks are terminal-success. This finding remains fixed rather than verified because current authority excludes Framework-master integration and resulting-master revalidation. No traceability or CI-security control is waived.
residual_risk_de: Der ursprüngliche Überschriftenvertragsfehler reproduziert auf dem exakten Head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194 nicht mehr: Die unveränderte CI-Security-Suite bestand alle 69 Tests und die Hosted Checks sind terminal-success. Dieser Befund bleibt fixed statt verified, weil die aktuelle Autorisierung Framework-master-Integration und Resulting-Master-Revalidation ausschließt. Kein Traceability- oder CI-Security-Control wird waived.

history.detail: The current master-provided CI-security suite ran 69 tests; only the paired PR #30 Change Record heading contract failed. The targeted repair is a level-2-to-level-3 heading adjustment in both records, with no checker or control change.

Exact PR #30 head a448d056ef98e745d8551c198b2e56d33fe38194 passed the unchanged 69-test CI-security suite, documentation checks, and all current hosted checks. The normal master refresh retains the repaired paired records; master integration remains outside the current authorization.
